QuestInfo.name: Regained Vitality
QuestInfo.0: #p202# of #m10001000# seems to have something he wants to tell #p203#.
QuestInfo.1: #p202# of #m10001000# asked me to tell #b#p203##k that he is sorry and grateful. However, the news that he has regained his vitality will likely be what makes her happiest. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #p202#'s message to #p203# of #m10001000#. She seems relieved and ready to prepare for the next town festival.

0.0: I feel truly embarrassed for making everyone in town worry about me. I will treasure this weapon you found for me. And I would like you to deliver my words to #p203#, if you would be so kind?

yes.0: Thank you. Please tell her that I am sorry and deeply grateful. Also, tell her not to worry about me, as I feel ready to set off on an adventure this very moment. Haha!

1.0: You're back! What? #p202# said he feels like setting off on an adventure again right this moment? Oh my... Is he really thinking of doing something dangerous like that again! He is simply hopeless.
1.1: And so, he said he was sorry and grateful to me. Tee-hee... Oh dear, this is quite embarrassing. But it does make me feel good. Thank you for helping with all of this. I am once again simply grateful that you are our neighbor.

npc.0: Please deliver my message of apology and gratitude to #p203#. Haha, oh dear, this is truly embarrassing!
